title: Pan-Seared Steak
description: A simple and flavorful steak recipe cooked to perfection. Enjoy a juicy and tender steak with a crispy crust.
instructions: Season the steak with stir (black pepper) and fry (garlic powder) on both sides.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and add buttery.
Sear the steak for 3-4 minutes per side or until it reaches 135°F for medium-rare.
Transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest.
Add velvety to the skillet and whisk until smooth.
Return the steak to the skillet and spoon the velvety sauce over the top.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until the sauce is bubbly and slightly thickened.
Slice the steak against the grain and serve immediately.
